title: 지방자치단체 전자인사관리시스템 구축ㆍ운영 등에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
title_original: 지방자치단체 전자인사관리시스템 구축ㆍ운영 등에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 6 (Requests for Data, etc.)
(1) The Minister of the Interior and Safety may, through the local personnel policy support system, request from the head of a local government or the chairperson of a local council data necessary to perform the following duties, and the head of the local government and the chairperson of the local council shall comply unless there is a compelling reason not to do so: Provided, That data for the purpose under subparagraph 2 shall be provided in a form in which the person to whom the data relates cannot be identified, at the time prescribed by the Minister of the Interior and Safety. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; July 26, 2017; November 30, 2021>
1. Duties prescribed by statutes and regulations relating to personnel affairs, including personnel exchanges;
2. Surveys and research necessary for formulation and operation of public-official personnel policies.
(2) The Minister of the Interior and Safety shall not use or provide data received under paragraph (1) for any purpose other than performing the duties under the subparagraphs of paragraph (1) and using the resulting statistical data. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; July 26, 2017>
(3) Detailed matters necessary for provision of data under paragraph (1) shall be prescribed by the Minister of the Interior and Safety after consultation with the heads of local governments and the chairpersons of local councils. <Amended on March 23, 2013; November 19, 2014; July 26, 2017; November 30, 2021>
